### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, A01 was not observed in any of the 200 traces; in the later window it occurs in about 47 in 100 traces, roughly twice in each trace where it appears (mean about 0.96 occurrences per trace, with repeats in about 23 in 100 traces), at an early-to-middle position (median relative position about 0.34). [OCC001, POS001]
- In the later window, about 76 in 100 of A01's outgoing transitions lead to A04, with smaller shares to A13 (about 10), A11 (about 7) and A12 (about 4); in the earlier window A01 had no observed outgoing transitions because it never occurred. [DIR001]
- Activities that previously led directly to A04 now often lead to A01 instead: A03→A04 fell from about 53 to about 10 in 100 of A03's outgoing transitions while A03→A01 appeared at about 42; A10→A04 fell from about 47 to about 13 while A10→A01 reached about 25; A11→A04 fell from about 96 to about 22 while A11→A01 became dominant at about 76. Smaller new edges into A01 arise from A04 (about 10 in 100), A13 (about 11) and A06 (about 6). [DIR003, DIR010, DIR011, DIR004, DIR013, DIR006]
- Pairwise event distances grew by about one step: A03→A04 moved from lag 1 (about 55 in 100 observations) to lag 2 (about 63); A10→A04 and A11→A04 likewise moved from lag 1 to lag 2; A03→A11 and A10→A11 moved from lag 3 to lag 4; repetitions of A04 and of A11 also shifted about one step later. [LAG001, LAG007, LAG009, LAG002, LAG008, LAG004, LAG011]
- A01 and A04 never co-occurred in the earlier window (A04 appeared without A01 in about 55 in 100 traces); in the later window they co-occur in about 47 in 100 traces, with A01 before A04 in about 20, A04 before A01 in about 5, and mixed or repeated order in about 23. A01 also began co-occurring with A03 (about 27 in 100), A10 (about 20) and A11 (about 23). [REL002, REL001, REL003, REL004]
- A04 shifted slightly later within traces (mean relative position about 0.39 to 0.44) and its participation eased from about 55 to 47 in 100 traces, the same small decline seen for A13; A04 still occurs in nearly half of all traces. [POS003, OCC004, OCC013]
- Minor participation shifts: A02 and A09 rose from about 46 to 53 in 100 traces while A05 and A12 fell from about 55 to 47; a few direction and lag items rest on only one to six observations and are not interpretable on their own. [OCC002, OCC009, OCC005, OCC012, DIR005, DIR009, LAG010]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that A01 was added as a new activity and inserted before A04, so that paths which previously ran directly from A03, A10 or A11 into A04 now typically pass through A01 first. A01 appears only in the later window (about 47 in 100 traces) and leads predominantly to A04; the former direct edges A03→A04, A10→A04 and A11→A04 lost most of their shares to new edges into A01; distances from A03, A10 and A11 to A04, and from A03 and A10 to the downstream A11, lengthened by about one step; and A01–A04 co-occurrence appeared in about 47 in 100 traces with A01 usually first. This is the pattern expected from adding one extra step ahead of A04. [OCC001, DIR001, DIR003, DIR010, DIR011, LAG001, LAG007, LAG009, LAG002, LAG008, REL002]

The main competing explanation the evidence cannot rule out is that A01 already existed but was too rare to appear in the earlier sample, since zero participation only means it was not observed in any of the 200 earlier traces; the rerouting and lag evidence make a frequently used pre-existing A01 unlikely, but not impossible. Further limitations: DIR shares are over outgoing transitions and POS and LAG use event positions, so the insertion point is inferred from order rather than clock time; A01 also receives edges from A04, A13 and A06 and repeats in about 23 in 100 traces, so it is not inserted at one fixed point in every trace; several items describe the same rerouting and are not independent confirmations; and no chance-expectation baseline was provided, so the judgement rests on the directness and consistency of these items. [OCC001, DIR001, DIR004, DIR013, DIR006, POS001, LAG001]

Other differences: the small participation shifts in A02, A09, A05, A12, A04 and A13 (each about 7–8 in 100 traces) are not clearly tied to the insertion of A01 and could reflect sampling variation between the two windows. [OCC002, OCC009, OCC005, OCC012, OCC004, OCC013]
